name: TM Forum frameworks
description: Telecom reference models: eTOM business processes, the SID information model, the Functional Framework, the Application Framework (TAM) and ODA Components. Load the Excel files you are licensed to use; Atrium turns them into a read-only reference layer you can map your own model to.
license: TM Forum material is largely member content. This pack contains only the importers; you supply the source files under your own TM Forum terms.

frameworks.name: eTOM Business Process Framework
frameworks.description: GB921 Processes in Excel: level 1 domains down to level 7, with their vertical groups.

frameworks.name: SID Information Framework
frameworks.description: GB922 Model in Excel: domains, aggregate business entities (ABEs) and business entities, with their attribute names.

frameworks.name: ODA Functional Framework
frameworks.description: GB1033F Functional Framework in Excel: functional domains, aggregate functions (levels 1 and 2) and functions.

frameworks.name: Application Framework (TAM)
frameworks.description: GB929F Application Framework in Excel: reference applications by domain, linked to the functions they contain.

frameworks.name: ODA Components
frameworks.description: A spreadsheet of ODA components with id, name and description columns.
